follow-up time: From gestational diabetes diagnosis to delivery
exposure: Glycemic control trajectories (stably optimal, rapidly improving to optimal, slowly improving to near-optimal, slowly improving to suboptimal)
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission and stay of 7 days or longer
cohort: Individuals with gestational diabetes with longitudinal electronic health record data from preconception to delivery who received prenatal care at Kaiser Permanente Northern California and were enrolled in their telemedicine-based gestational diabetes care program between January 2007 and December 2017
finding: Slowly improving to near-optimal and slowly improving to suboptimal glycemic control trajectories were associated with increased risk of perinatal complications compared to rapidly improving to optimal trajectory.
